title: Semi-Amortized Bayesian Inference with Reusable Local Posteriors
abstract: arXiv:2610.18945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Amortized Bayesian inference uses simulations to perform Bayesian estimation when likelihoods are expensive or analytically unavailable. However, learning the full joint posterior is challenging in high-dimensional models with complex dependencies. We introduce a semi-amortized method that divides parameters into smaller blocks, and uses conditional independence to identify the information needed to infer each block. We train neural estimators for blocks whose posterior updates are computationally expensive or frequently repeated. Each estimator learns from simulations of the relevant model components to approximate the block's full conditional posterior, given the relevant observations and the values of the variables on which it depends. A Markov chain then alternates direct draws from these estimators with conventional updates of the remaining variables. translated_title: 具有可复用局部后验的半摊销贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 摊销贝叶斯推断利用模拟来执行贝叶斯估计，适用于似然函数计算代价高昂或无法解析获得的情形。然而，在具有复杂依赖关系的高维模型中，学习完整的联合后验分布极具挑战性。我们提出了一种半摊销方法，将参数划分为较小的块，并利用条件独立性来识别推断每个块所需的信息。对于后验更新计算代价高昂或频繁重复的块，我们为其训练神经估计器。每个估计器从相关模型组件的模拟中学习，在给定相关观测值及其所依赖变量取值的情况下，近似该块的完整条件后验分布。随后，马尔可夫链在直接从这些估计器采样与对剩余变量进行常规更新之间交替进行。每次神经更新都使用当前的条件变量取值，并且既不需要似然……
tldr: 该论文提出一种半摊销贝叶斯推断方法，将参数分块并为计算昂贵或频繁更新的块训练可复用的神经估计器来近似局部条件后验，再通过马尔可夫链将这些神经采样与常规更新交替进行，从而高效地实现高维复杂模型的贝叶斯推断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a semi-amortized Bayesian inference method that partitions parameters into blocks, trains reusable neural estimators to approximate local conditional posteriors for expensive or frequently repeated updates, and alternates these neural draws with conventional updates within a Markov chain, enabling efficient Bayesian inference in high-dimensional models.
